facts.text: Jon mentioned that he had a performance at a festival where many people complimented his dance moves.

evidence.quote: Remenber the festival I told you about? Had that performance and it was awesome - so many people there complementing my dance moves.

facts.text: Jon expressed that he loves running his own dance studio because it allows him the freedom to create a space for dancers of all ages and levels.

evidence.quote: I love running my own studio. It's great having the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages and levels express themselves.

facts.text: Jon mentioned that he feels fulfilled by seeing his students progress in their dance abilities.

evidence.quote: I'm super thrilled about dancing each day and seeing my students progress. It's so fulfilling.
